title: INFO: invalid Dandiset metadata
reason: This Dandiset has invalid metadata.
solution: Required dataset description fields are inferred from the raw metadata instead.

title: Missing participant sex
reason: Archives such as DANDI or EMBER require the subject sex to be specified.
solution:
Specify the `sex` field of the Subject object attached to the NWB file as one of four options: "M" (for male), "F" (for female), "U" (for unknown), or "O" (for other).
NOTE: for certain animal species with more specific genetic determinants, such as C elegans, use "O" (for other) then further specify the subtypes using other custom fields. For example, `c_elegans_sex="XO"`
